segments.he: מוהרנ"ת ז"ל אמר מי שאין לו התבודדות ואינו לומד פוסקים בזה היום שאינו מקיים אלו הב' שיעורים בזה היום אינו חסיד ברסלבי:
segments.en: Rabbainu also said: the Sefer HaGanuz [Hidden Book] is great — no eye has seen it, no creature knows even a word from it, only Mashiach will explain it. And the burnt book is great. But my Rosh HaShanah is even greater: "Viya der Sefer HaGanuz iz groys, der Sefer HaNisraf iz — mayn Rosh HaShanah nokh greser." [Just as the Hidden Book is great and the Burnt Book is — my Rosh HaShanah is even greater.] He also said: "Were it not for my Rosh HaShanah, the world would become tohu vavohu." "Ven nit mayn Rosh HaShanah volt di velt gevorn tohu vavohu."
